content:
In early December, Dao is getting ready for a holiday in Sapa with her husband and their two children. She has heard that it can be very cold in the mountains, so she is talking to her neighbour, Mrs Hoa, who visited Sapa last winter.

Dao asks, "How cold was it?"
"Freezing! One morning it was only two degrees. You'll need warm coats, hats and good boots."
"We have winter coats, but we haven't worn them for years. They smell a bit."
"Then get them dry-cleaned. There's a good shop near the market. I had my coat cleaned there before my trip, and it came back like new."
"How long does it take?"
"Usually three days. But if you pay a little more, you can have them done in one day."
"Good. We leave on Friday. What about boots? My leather boots have a broken zip."
"You can get the zip repaired at the shoe stall on Tran Phu Street. The man there fixes everything."
"Will it be expensive?"
"Not at all. I had a new zip put in for eighty thousand dong."
"That's cheap. My son's boots are too small, though. He's grown so much this year."
"Then you'll have to buy new ones. Don't wait until Sapa. Prices are higher there."
"Thanks. Anything else?"
"Take gloves for the children. And have your photos printed when you come back. The views are amazing."
Dao laughs. "I will. I'll bring you back some Sapa tea."
"Lovely. Have a wonderful trip."

grammarNote.title: Thể nhờ làm (have / get something done)
grammarNote.bodyVi: Thể nhờ làm dùng khi khuyên ai đó mang đồ đi sửa, giặt: Then get them dry-cleaned (câu mệnh lệnh). You can get the zip repaired at the shoe stall. Khi kể lại kinh nghiệm, dùng quá khứ: I had my coat cleaned there before my trip. Nếu trả thêm tiền để làm nhanh: you can have them done in one day.
examples: I had my coat cleaned there before my trip, and it came back like new."

turns.text: Hello. Can I have these three coats dry-cleaned?
turns.meaningVi: Chào em. Chị giặt khô ba chiếc áo khoác này được không?

turns.text: Of course. When do you need them?
turns.meaningVi: Được ạ. Khi nào chị cần?

turns.text: By Thursday. We're going to Sapa on Friday.
turns.meaningVi: Trước thứ Năm. Thứ Sáu nhà chị đi Sa Pa.

turns.text: Normally it takes three days. Do you want the express service?
turns.meaningVi: Bình thường mất ba ngày. Chị có muốn dùng dịch vụ nhanh không?

turns.text: Twenty thousand dong per coat. You'll have them done tomorrow.
turns.meaningVi: Thêm hai mươi nghìn một áo. Mai là xong.

turns.text: OK, let's do that. Can you get this button sewn back on too?
turns.meaningVi: Ừ, làm thế đi. Em đơm lại chiếc cúc này luôn được không?

turns.text: Yes, we can. Is anything else damaged?
turns.meaningVi: Được ạ. Còn chỗ nào hỏng nữa không chị?

turns.text: No. Just the button. Thank you!
turns.meaningVi: Không. Chỉ cái cúc thôi. Cảm ơn em!

turns.text: Here's your ticket. Have a lovely trip!
turns.meaningVi: Phiếu của chị đây. Chúc chị đi chơi vui!

Lời khuyên: nên mang gì, nên mang gì đi sửa / giặt (Get … cleaned / Have … repaired).
Kinh nghiệm của chính bạn (I had my … ).
writingHelp.modelAnswer: Ha Giang will be very cold in January, so you need to prepare well. Get your winter jacket cleaned before you go, because you haven't worn it for a year. You should also have your boots repaired. Last winter I had my old boots fixed at a stall near the market, and they were fine for the whole trip. Don't forget gloves and a warm hat.
